claude.take: MCGM Western Suburbs cooperative-society redevelopment specialist, #1 by launches CY21-24 — a real niche in Mumbai's crowded redevelopment market. FY26 PAT grew to ₹71.32 Cr, but RoNW fell from 47.17% to 33.78% despite the profit growth, meaning the equity base grew faster than returns — worth checking whether that's fresh capital sitting idle pre-IPO or a genuine dilution of return quality. Peer multiples in the Mumbai redevelopment space are extremely wide (Arkade at 482.59x is not a usable anchor), so the eventual price band will matter more than any peer comparison.
